messages:
deploy-bot: CONFIG DEPLOY STARTED by santiago.m — config-only, targets: routing-policy, qos, batching. Change window 03:00-04:00 UTC. Diff: /configs/route-qos-v2 -> /prod

amanda.p: heads-up: is this the change that pins traffic for the new route preference?

santiago.m: yes — we push policy that prefers region-local first, then fallback pool. also tightening per-request soft_timeout from 6s -> 4s.

kevin: ok on timeouts, but we should lower concurrency limit for canary to 8 per pod for first 30m. avoids rough queues.

irina: note: batching window increased from 12ms -> 18ms for small requests (this improves throughput for embeddings). that might add tail latency for some low-token calls.

liz: can we add a strict fallback rule if route_local saturates? e.g., route: prefer_local, fallback_after: 120s -> immediately try remote after N5 failures.

santiago.m: plan is prefer_local, fallback_after=10s, but we can make aggressive fallback for low-latency endpoints. which endpoints should be aggressive?

amanda.p: /v1/chat and realtime routes should be aggressive fallback. embeddings can tolerate longer fallback.

kevin: deploy-bot, please pin current model-version for the canary to avoid accidental model swap during this rollout. set model_pin: "gptx-2026-rc1" for the affected routes.

deploy-bot: Received request: apply_pin(model_pin=gptx-2026-rc1) — applying to routes: /v1/chat, /v1/realtime-canary — will not change model binaries.

deploy-bot: APPLY CONFIG PATCH:
```
{"routing": {"prefer_local": true, "fallback_after_ms": 10000, "fallback_policy": "region_remote"},
"qos": {"soft_timeout_ms": 4000, "hard_timeout_ms": 12000, "max_concurrency": 8},
"batching": {"small_window_ms": 18, "max_batch_size": 64},
"model_pin": "gptx-2026-rc1",
"canary_percentage": 5,
"canary_duration_min": 30}
```

irina: thanks. will watch tail-latency dashboards and eval set. I’ll spike the eval job now.

amanda.p: Rollout notes to post: 1) config-only change — no model binaries 2) pinned model for canary 3) concurrency reduced to 8 for canary 4) small requests batching window increased -> watch chat tail latency 5) routing prefers local with 10s fallback 6) canary 5% 30m

deploy-bot: CANARY STARTED — 5% traffic at 03:05 UTC. config applied to 12 pods in us-west and eu-west.

kevin: starting synthetic load against /v1/chat to exercise fallback path.

irina: eval job kicked off — using regen tests + perf harness. posting initial metrics in 10m.

(10m later)

irina: quick findings: p95 chat latency +12ms vs baseline (expected with batching); p99 unchanged. error rate unchanged. fallback executions ~0.8% of canary requests (mostly region-remote hits).

kevin: under synth load fallback triggered as expected, concurrency held at 8. queues stable. memory use normal.

amanda.p: thumbs-up. keep canary for full 30m and then bump to 25% if no regressions.

santiago.m: agree. schedule bump at 03:40 UTC if no alerts. ops will be oncall.

deploy-bot: CANARY COMPLETED (30m) — no critical alerts. metrics: error_rate +0.02%, p95 +12ms, fallback_rate 0.8%. Proceed with staged increase to 25% at 03:45 UTC unless an objection.

liz: no objections. one ask for rollback plan: what to revert exactly if we see sustained p95 +50ms?

kevin: rollback plan: revert routing/fallback and batching window to previous values, remove model_pin (so model version stays the same). concurrency -> 20. This is config-only revert, should be fast.

amanda.p: assign rollback owner = santiago.m, notify list #eng-oncall, #prod-ops. Include runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/config-rollbacks

santiago.m: acknowledged. will hold off unless bump needed.

deploy-bot: STAGED ROLLOUT: 25% @ 03:45 UTC. applying to additional 48 pods.

(15m later)

irina: monitoring shows p95 stable, no error uptick. fallback rate steady. all good.

kevin: concurrency headroom ok, no queueing spikes.

amanda.p: proceeding to full rollout: 100% at 04:05 UTC? we are still in change window til 04:00. should we extend?

santiago.m: proposal: finish staged rollouts to 50% by 04:00, then pause; finish final 100% in off-window 04:30 if all clear.

liz: agree with staged finish and off-window final to be conservative.

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT PAUSED @ 04:00 UTC (policy: change-window end). current coverage: 50%. awaiting approval for final 100% at 04:30 UTC.

amanda.p: postmortem note: this was config-only change, pinned model for canary, reduced canary concurrency, increased small-batch window. No rollback needed. Thanks team. :party_parrot:
